player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i tetahi {max_rounds} raunga taonga Kuhn Poker.
Ngā Ture o te Taonga:
- Ka whakamahia e Kuhn Poker te pukapuka 3-kāri me J, Q, K (J te papa, K te teitei)
- Ka homai e tētahi kaitakaro {ante} hipi me te kāri kotahi i ia raunga (ki te kore, ko ngā kāri ka whakawhiwhia, kāore e taea te whiwhi i te kāri kotahi me to koutou hoariri).
- Ka haere tonu te taonga mo {max_rounds} raunga
- Ko te kaitakaro me te maha o ngā hipi i muri i ngā raunga katoa e toa ana
Ngā Ture o te Mahi:
- '[check]': Tukua te mahi kaore he whakatau (ki te kore he whakatau i runga i te tepu)
- '[bet]': Tāpiri 1 hipi ki te pūtea (ki te kore he whakatau i runga i te tepu)
- '[call]': Whakaae ki te whakatau a te hoariri e tāpiri ana 1 hipi ki te pūtea
- '[fold]': Tukua te ringa me whakaae ki te hoariri ki te toa i te pūtea
